mainEntity.name: What are common challenges contractors face with AEO and how can they be overcome?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges for contractors in AEO include identifying the most frequently asked questions by their target audience, crafting concise and accurate answers that search engines can easily extract, and continuously updating content to reflect new queries or service offerings. Overcoming these challenges involves robust keyword research, content audits to identify gaps, implementing structured data (schema markup), and consistent monitoring of search engine results pages (SERPs) for direct answer opportunities. Regular client feedback can also help refine content to directly address real-world questions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Challenges include identifying key questions, crafting concise answers, and continuous content updates. Overcome them with keyword research, content audits, schema markup, and SERP monitoring.
